certificate.claims: no threshold on the grid satisfies the bound; the certificate is ABSENT and the policy must abstain rather than claim risk control
certificate.rule: select the largest calibration acceptance level (most permissive threshold) whose UCB(R_hat) <= alpha, scanning the grid once from most to least permissive and stopping at the first feasible level (Learn-then-Test / fixed-sequence); the guarantee covers this selection rule, not any threshold chosen after looking at test data

certificate_at_alpha_0_25.claims: with probability >= 1-delta over the calibration draw, the selective risk of the returned threshold is <= alpha (bounded loss, i.i.d. calibration)
